title_en: At Vila Gold, 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment!!!
description_en: At Vila Gold, on "Gjon Buzuku" street, 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment. The apartment has a gross area of ​​63 m2, net 55 m2 and is located on the second residential floor of a 10-story building which is in the initial stages of construction.
